transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I'm just... I'm really tired. It's not the kind of tired where you just need a nap. It's more like... even doing small things, like emptying the dishwasher, or trying to read for my classes... it just feels like too much.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
I guess so. Yeah. Just... down, mostly.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah. I guess I just... stopped caring about things. Things that usually make me feel like myself. Like... I haven't been sketching, or cooking. I don't really want to go to gallery openings, or do yoga... or even play tennis with my friend. I just don't have the interest right now.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Um... I guess about three months. Just... this quiet stretch where I'm so tired and don't care about much. Yeah, around three months.
Did something stressful happen around the time these feelings started?
Um... no. Not really. Just... nothing specific stands out. It just sort of happened.
For most of the past three months, have you felt sad or down nearly every day?
Um... I don't think so. Not sad, exactly. I just... I don't really feel much of anything. Kind of blank, I guess.
Have you had trouble sleeping?
Um... no. Not really. I think I sleep fine. Just... normal, I guess.
Have you been feeling worthless or guilty lately?
Um... no. I don't think so. I haven't really felt like that. Just... no.
Before this started three months ago, have you ever had another period like this in your life?
I... I don't really remember feeling quite like this before. So... no, I guess not.
Have you noticed a change in your appetite lately?

Um... maybe a little. I guess it's been kind of off. Sometimes I just... I'll realize I've only had coffee and a few bites of something all day. And... my jeans are a little looser, I guess. Even though I haven't been trying to lose weight. But... yeah.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?

I guess so, yeah. Sometimes I just... I'll sit with my planning app open on my phone, and I just can't decide what to do. Like, whether I should work on a class assignment or... pay a bill, or even just start dinner. It's just hard to choose. So I end up just... sitting there for a while, not doing any of it.
Have you felt slowed down lately, like your body or thoughts are moving more slowly than usual?

Um... yeah, sometimes. I guess on my slower days it just... it feels heavy. Like I'm moving through wet cement. And... if my husband asks me something simple, it just... takes me a weirdly long time to answer him. I don't really know why.
Have you had any thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?
Um... no. Not really. I just... I don't think about that kind of stuff. I'm just tired, I guess.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about different things?
Um... no. Not really. Just the normal stuff, I guess. Nothing... nothing major.
Have you been feeling hopeless lately?
I don't think so. I mean... I haven't really felt like that. Just... slow, like I said.
Have you been feeling unusually cold lately?
Cold? Um... no. Not that I've noticed.
Before these past three months, have you generally felt depressed or down most days for a long time?
Um... no. I don't think so. Before this, I was mostly just... fine. Not down like that, anyway.
Have you been constipated lately?
Um... no. I haven't had any issues with that.
Have your periods been heavier than usual lately?
No, not really. They've been pretty normal.
Have you noticed your hair thinning or falling out more than usual lately?
Um... no. Not that I've noticed.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient reports a first episode of depressive symptoms lasting about 3 months, including low mood/feeling blank, markedly reduced interest or pleasure, fatigue/loss of energy, decreased appetite with unintentional weight loss, impaired concentration/indecisiveness, and psychomotor slowing. Symptoms cause functional difficulty with chores, schoolwork, and daily decision-making. She denies prior chronic depression, clear psychosocial trigger, suicidality, guilt, insomnia, and significant anxiety. Medical differentials considered were hypothyroidism and anemia due to fatigue/psychomotor slowing, but key supporting symptoms were not endorsed (no cold intolerance, constipation, hair loss, heavy menses).
